title: Assess defined verification coverage
statement: As a product manager, I can see how each accepted criterion will be verified and which mappings need attention so I can inspect the verification approach without mistaking it for an execution result.

acceptance_criteria.statement: For each accepted criterion, Quality reports definition coverage only when every policy-required kind is supplied by a current proposed or active linked case with allowed automation and current mappings; code evidence and runs are not required for planned verification.

Quality identifies missing kinds or step mappings, stale references, inactive definitions, invalid links, conflicts, exclusions and disallowed automation without reporting execution success or failure.
